provenance: Original synthetic LiquidBench held-out evaluation fixture, authored 2026-10-24 before any training data. Final-model evaluation only; never shown to training-data generation.
runtime_subset: Core Ruby Liquid with supplied hashes only; or static schema/reference contracts. No Shopify service emulation.
prompt: Repair snippets/rating-stars.liquid. product.rating is an integer 0 to 5 and product.review_count a nonnegative integer. Output one div class=rating with aria-label R out of 5 stars (R is the rating). Inside it, first one span class=stars whose text is R copies of ★ followed by 5-R copies of ☆. Then, only when review_count is above 0, one span class=count with text (1 review) when the count is 1, otherwise (N reviews). Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/rating-stars.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
